newsitem.title: GREECE: BOURSE SAYS NO OFFICIAL LIST OF BROKERS TRADING WEDS.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE SAYS NO OFFICIAL LIST OF BROKERS TRADING WEDS.

text.p: Athens bourse official Christos Xygakis told reporters after the close that the exchange would not provide an official list of exchange members that were admitted for trading on Wednesday.
"I am following orders from higher ups," Xygakis said.
Unconfirmed sources told Reuters that out of the 65 member brokers, 19 were absent from trade on Wednesday.
The Athens general share index closed down 1.35 percent or 12.39 points lower at 908.42 on very low turnover of 603.6 million drachmas.

Losers led gainers 58 to 30 with 14 stocks unchanged on 102 traded. From a sectoral viewpoint, banks lost 1.84 percent, industrials closed 0.92 percent lower, construction fell 0.56 percent and small-caps dropped 0.79 percent.
Trading was expected to resume normally on Thursday, brokers said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
